title: Rooftop Deck Views, 8 Beds, 10 Min to Broadway
description:
Enjoy this spacious four-story townhome only 10min from Downtown Nashville, Broadway, & more! The townhome features 4 bedrooms, 8 beds, 4 bathrooms, a rooftop deck, a 2nd-floor patio, & a private garage.

HIGHLIGHTS
- 8 Beds
- Ping Pong
- Free WiFi
- Private Garage
- Kitchen & Bathroom Essentials
- Washer & Dryer w/ Tide Pods
- Smart Lock w/ Unique Access Code
- Bag Drop Off, Early Check-In & Late Check-Out Options

The space
LEVEL ONE
The first floor features a guest bedroom with a queen bed and an ensuite bathroom.

LEVEL TWO
The second floor features a kitchen, living room, garage access, and a small outdoor patio. There is no formal dining area, but the kitchen offers a breakfast bar for casual meals.

LEVEL THREE
The third floor features the primary bedroom and a guest bedroom. The primary bedroom contains a king-sized bed in addition to an ensuite bathroom. The guest bedroom offers two queen beds with an ensuite bathroom and a shower/tub combo. Additionally, the washer and dryer are located on the second floor.

LEVEL FOUR
The fourth floor contains a guest bedroom featuring two sets of bunk beds with four twin mattresses and an ensuite bathroom. Additionally, the fourth floor has a wet bar and access to the rooftop deck with downtown views. The rooftop deck features a dining table and ample seating.

PARKING
The attached garage can accommodate one vehicle, and there is street parking in front of the unit. We do not provide a garage door opener.

Guest access
Guests will have access to the entire home except for a locked owner's closet. They'll receive a four-digit access code before arrival to enter the unit through our Schlage Encode smart lock. Additionally, there will be an onsite lockbox accessible in case of a smart lock failure. We provide 24/7 customer support to ensure you never get locked out. We also enhance property security with a Ring doorbell.

Other things to note
We are the following minutes away from these destinations by car:
- 10 minutes from Broadway, Ryman Auditorium, Nissan Stadium & Bridgestone Arena
- 18 minutes from Grand Ole Opry & Opry Mills Mall
- 18 minutes from the Nashville International Airport (BNA)
- 15 minutes from Geodis Park (Home to Nashville SC)
- 12 minutes from Belmont University
- 10 minutes from Vanderbilt University
